description: Launch a partitioned materialization from a run-config form. Reads user-provided config (via Dagster's launchpad or an external RunConfig POST), formats a partition key from `partition_key_template`, registers it on a dynamic partitions definition, then materializes the target asset selection with that partition_key. The launcher is the config-shaped entry point; the target is the actual partitioned pipeline.

outputs.description: One launcher run + one inner materialization run per invocation. Target assets are partitioned on the computed partition_key.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Dagster job name for the launcher itself (shows in the UI as a job you can materialize).

target_asset_keys.label: Target Asset Keys
target_asset_keys.description: Asset keys to materialize in the launched partitioned run. MUST be dynamic-partitioned on `dynamic_partitions_name` (typically declared in a sibling partitioned-multi-asset component). Multi-part keys are dot-joined: 'foo/bar' → AssetKey(['foo', 'bar']).

dynamic_partitions_name.label: Dynamic Partitions Name
dynamic_partitions_name.description: Name of the DynamicPartitionsDefinition on the target assets. The launcher registers the computed partition key on this def before firing the materialization.

partition_key_template.label: Partition Key Template
partition_key_template.description: Format template composing the partition key from config field values. e.g. `'{owner}/{repo}#{issue_number}'` — each `{name}` placeholder maps to a config_schema field. The target asset can invert this via its own `partition_key_parser:` field.

config_schema.label: Config Schema
config_schema.description: Config fields exposed on the launcher's launchpad form (and via run_config for programmatic launches). Shape: `{field_name: {type: str|int|float|bool, default: <value>}}`. Fields without `default` are required in the form.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags applied to the launcher run.

name: Partitioned Asset Launcher Job
